mapper.sql: c.ccode, c.bcode, c."idNumber", c.content, c."createdAt", c."updatedAt", m."userName" AS "authorName"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.comment c LEFT JOIN public.member m ON m.number = c."idNumber" WHERE c.ccode = #{ccode}
SELECT count(*) FROM public.comment WHERE bcode = #{bcode}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.comment WHERE ccode = #{ccode} AND "idNumber" = #{idNumber}
